observations.name: V8 CPU profile
observations.mechanism: CLI flags shown in proposedCommand; keep generated PID/TID/sequence filenames. Match profiles to observed test runner and isolated test PID rather than treating parent profile as test work.
observations.canDistinguish: Sampled JavaScript/native/GC owner-frame distribution within the actually profiled process; can identify candidate expensive owners and distinguish samples marked idle from owner work.
observations.cannotDistinguish: No scheduler attribution, exact blocking reason, complete arbitrary child/thread accounting, or proof assertion credit. Profile samples are not process CPU accounting. Startup-to-exit scope differs from earlier single-call profiles. Profiling overhead may change timing. Missing/incomplete profiles stay unavailable.
observations.retention: Profiles remain within the existing4GiB aggregate owned cap, checked by the unchanged operational disk monitor. No separate new profile quota or monitor is proposed. Generated PID/TID/sequence filenames prevent shared fixed-name collision and output stays outside BUILT003.

observations.name: Per-process CPU versus elapsed

mechanism.schedule: Before start, then at10s intervals while live, plus one after close; at most61 probes; no overlapping probe, record skipped/gap observations.
mechanism.retention: Retain owned descendants and host ancestry only; no unrelated command arguments or environment. Track PID+start time to avoid treating a reused PID as the same process.
mechanism.comparison: For same observed identity use delta cumulative time(user+system) / delta monotonic observer elapsed. Retain raw fields, actual acquisition times and intervals; do not substitute ps %cpu or load average.

observations.canDistinguish: Observed CPU consumption versus elapsed progression per owned process, including npm/tar/worker descendants if captured; parent waiting can be compared with observed child CPU.
observations.cannotDistinguish: Low CPU can mean sleeping, IO, scheduling delay or other waits. Short-lived or detached unknown children can be missed. Summed visible deltas are a lower-bound observed total, not full job accounting. No conclusion from an incomplete probe.

observations.name: One live durable-event extent observation

mechanism.trigger: Once at command-relative300s if still live; otherwise record not attempted. Actual timer firing time is retained; no guarantee if observer itself is delayed.
mechanism.directoryDiscovery: One nonrecursive streaming enumeration of owned TMPDIR, capped128 names. Require exactly one real nonsymlink abi5-root-env-* directory; no broader search or repeated attempt.
mechanism.read: One descriptor tail read at observed size; retain only complete newline-terminated rows. Discard partial boundary rows. Recognize inline event or the existing event-body reference wrapper and extract only envelope metadata; do not invoke Product decoder/replay or restore payload references.
mechanism.doNotRetain: Payloads, source text, context bodies or reconstructed results.

observations.canDistinguish: Positive evidence that setup admitted durable events and a lower bound on held-Run progress visible in the sampled window. Event metadata can locate observed run lifecycle boundaries.
observations.cannotDistinguish: Missing log does not diagnose setup or cleanup. Tail counts are not whole-history counts. Cold row assertions and later worker/content checks do not necessarily append events; absence of new events cannot separate those phases or prove a stall. Semantic success still requires final case and OWN diagnostic.

processOwnership.tree: Existing external proof host -> commandRecorder-owned process-group file-host -> test-runner Node -> isolated OWN test-file Node -> normal test-owned fixture processes. Observation ps processes belong to the external host and are separately labelled.
processOwnership.identity: Bind exact Node/manual/ps and stage pins before any selection; record actual PID/PPID/PGID/start time, command receipt and resulting profile filenames. Future PIDs are unknown, not prefilled.
processOwnership.stop: Existing owned command process-group stop behavior only; no signals to unrelated host processes, no detached-child absence guarantee, no cleanup.

proposedBounds.enforcement: Operational sampled bounds, not a filesystem quota; overshoot possible. Observation failure does not extend the command or weaken assertions.
